question: Why must kala itself be declared, lest the universe be one?
premises: otherwise the universe would be one; for action, other-denial
thus in Matanga-scripture and the rest
what is declared, that kala itself
inference: Without kala, all collapses to one and action is denied; Matanga declares her.
plain_english: Otherwise the universe would be one — for action, thus other-denial; thus in Matanga-scripture and the rest, what is declared, that kala itself.
